reason: Hypothesis A directly addresses the room-temperature ductility limitation of NbMoTaW by proposing a physically sound microstructural change (inverted BCC+B2) supported by cited evidence on refractory high-entropy alloys, with a specific, testable intervention and clear falsification experiment. Hypothesis B relies on evidence from a different alloy system (tungsten-based with Ni/Fe/Ta) and proposes nanoprecipitates without a clear mechanism for ductility improvement in this specific BCC refractory alloy, making it less grounded and less likely to succeed.
